name: Land of Ruins
description:
About This Game

《Land of Ruins》 is a classic hex-grid turn-based strategy RPG, blending light Roguelike elements with open-world map exploration, while focusing on faction synergies and character progression. Randomly distributed resources and enemies in each run provide greater replayability.

You need to recruit heroes in the Land of Ruins, explore the map, and continuously grow stronger through adventure and battle. Build faction synergy playstyles, combine skills and talents, complete quests, face the pursuit of dark overlords, and become a legend of the Land of Ruins!

  • Provides around 15 hours of gameplay for a first playthrough, with even richer replay value across multiple runs.

  • Planned 24 unique characters, each with exclusive skills and talents. Build your team around them, expand your squad to gain faction synergy bonuses, and manage resources wisely to develop your characters.

  • Planned total of 90 unique mechanic-based equipment pieces, combined with 560 talents and skills, offering countless builds and playstyles for satisfying strategic combat.

Action Points, Speed, Armor, Counterattacks, Evasion, Coordinated Attacks, and more are all part of the experience. Facing randomly distributed enemies, resources, and quests, every step requires careful planning. Manage resources while exploring the map to strengthen your team, and make use of terrain, skills, and class combinations in battle to adapt to changing situations and achieve victory.

Each character comes with a unique talent and skill, and is assigned different attributes and factions based on their role. Build your team wisely and combine faction synergies to gain powerful bonuses, or equip class accessories to unlock even more faction effects. Upgrade talents and skills, equip gear based on your own strategy, and create your ultimate adventure squad.

The fog is filled with danger, but also countless opportunities. Use firelight sources to illuminate the world and dispel the darkness, fully exploring every corner of the open map. However, defeating enemies or using high-brightness campfires will attract the attention of powerful foes, causing them to draw closer to your position.

  • Grow Stronger Beyond Each Run

Whether you achieve victory or fall in battle, you will earn Knowledge Scrolls.
Use them to unlock permanent upgrades and new abilities, empowering your future adventures.
